content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Official Notification
content_sections.text: The Scheduled Tribes Development Department, Government of Kerala, issued Notification No. C2/17788/2021 on 17 November 2026 for the Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026–27. The notification and accompanying application form contain information about the 250 vacancies, eligible Scheduled Tribe applicants, accepted qualifications, age limit, monthly honorarium, training duration, submission method and application deadline. Kerala Scheduled Tribes Development Department Notification The official recruitment document consists of the notification and prescribed application form. Candidates should obtain the current official document from the department or the relevant district office.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Scheduled Tribes Development Department has specified the notification date and the last date for receiving applications. Candidates must ensure that their completed application and supporting documents reach the designated office within the prescribed deadline. Important: The application must reach the relevant district office before 5:00 PM on 5 December 2026. Candidates submitting applications by post should account for delivery time.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Vacancy 2026 - Qualification-wise Details
content_sections.text: The Kerala Scheduled Tribes Development Department has announced 250 training opportunities for qualified Scheduled Tribe candidates in nursing and paramedical disciplines. The notification provides a qualification-wise distribution of 150 degree-level and 100 diploma-level positions. It does not specify a separate vacancy count for each nursing, pharmacy or paramedical course.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in the Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 should first check their Scheduled Tribe eligibility, educational qualification, professional registration and age. This programme is specifically intended for qualified applicants belonging to the Scheduled Tribe communities of Kerala. Can freshers apply? Yes. The notification does not prescribe previous employment experience. Candidates who have completed a recognised nursing or paramedical qualification and possess the required council registration may apply if they satisfy the other conditions. Important: This summary is for quick reference only. Candidates must meet all eligibility requirements in the official notification. Participation in the training programme does not guarantee permanent employment.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must have successfully completed a nursing, pharmacy or other paramedical degree or diploma recognised by the Government, Directorate of Medical Education (DME) or relevant university, as applicable. The notification accepts qualifications under the following broad categories: Candidates possessing a recognised degree in Nursing, Pharmacy or another paramedical discipline can apply under the degree-qualified trainee category. There are 150 training vacancies for candidates in this category. Selected degree-qualified trainees will receive a monthly honorarium of ₹18,000. Candidates who have successfully completed GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery), ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery) or another recognised paramedical diploma may apply under the diploma-qualified trainee category. There are 100 vacancies for diploma-qualified trainees, with a monthly honorarium of ₹15,000. Applicants must possess registration with the relevant nursing or paramedical professional council. The official application form requests the professional registration number and registration date. Important: Completing a qualification without the required professional council registration does not satisfy the full educational eligibility stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit for the Tribal Paramedics Trainee programme is 21 to 35 years. Applicants must provide supporting proof of date of birth. The application form specifically requires an SSLC certificate copy for age verification. The notification does not specify a separate age-relaxation table or an explicit age-calculation cut-off date. Candidates should follow the instructions issued by the department regarding these conditions.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Honorarium 2026
content_sections.text: The programme provides a fixed monthly honorarium to selected trainees. The amount depends on whether the candidate holds a recognised degree or diploma. The amounts shown are monthly training honorariums, not permanent government pay scales.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Training Duration and Posting
content_sections.text: The Tribal Paramedics Trainee programme is designed to provide practical work exposure to qualified Scheduled Tribe candidates in Kerala's healthcare system. Selected candidates may be placed at Health Department institutions ranging from primary healthcare centres to medical colleges. Trainees must comply with the directions and orders issued by the Health Department and Scheduled Tribes Development Department during the engagement. Important: The notification clearly states that the engagement is entirely temporary and training-oriented. Selected candidates cannot claim future permanent appointment solely on the basis of this programme.

rows.details: Primary Health Centres, Hospitals and Medical Colleges under the Health Department
No entitlement to permanent employment through this programme

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Scheduled Tribes Development Department has invited applications from eligible candidates for selection to the training programme. The notification does not prescribe a written examination pattern, interview schedule, marks-based selection formula or detailed merit-list procedure. Candidates should submit accurate information and the required supporting certificates. Any subsequent selection instructions must be followed as communicated by the department or the relevant district office.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit the prescribed application form along with self-attested copies of the documents needed to establish their community, age, educational qualification and professional registration. Scheduled Tribe community or caste certificate SSLC certificate or equivalent proof of date of birth Educational qualification certificates Relevant nursing, pharmacy or paramedical degree/diploma certificate Educational marksheets Professional council registration certificate Other supporting documents required by the application form or district office The application form also provides space for a passport-size photograph. Candidates should complete the form accurately and ensure that the supporting document copies are self-attested.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted offline using the prescribed application form. Candidates can submit the completed form in person or by post to the Tribal Development Office or ITDP Project Office in the district where they are applying. Visit the official Scheduled Tribes Development Department website at stdd.kerala.gov.in , or obtain the prescribed form from the relevant district office. Get the Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026–27 application form. Enter your full name, address, contact number and email address. Specify the district in which you are applying. Enter your community, caste, date of birth and other personal information. Provide educational qualification details from SSLC onwards, including the nursing or paramedical qualification. Enter the relevant professional council registration number and date. Affix the passport-size photograph and complete the declaration with your signature. Attach self-attested copies of the required certificates and marksheets. Submit the completed application in person or by post to the appropriate district Tribal Development Office or ITDP Project Office. Ensure that the application reaches the office before 5:00 PM on 5 December 2026. Important: A candidate cannot submit applications in more than one district. Applicants must choose one district and submit the prescribed form to the relevant office.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Address
content_sections.text: The application must be submitted to either of the following offices in the relevant district: District Tribal Development Office Integrated Tribal Development Project (ITDP) Office Application Deadline: 5 December 2026, before 5:00 PM. Candidates should use the address of the relevant district office rather than automatically sending their completed application to the department's headquarters in Thiruvananthapuram. The notification states that information and prescribed application forms are also available from District Tribal Development Offices, ITDP Project Offices and Tribal Extension Offices.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The supplied recruitment notification does not specify an application fee for the Tribal Paramedics Trainee programme. Applicants should follow the official instructions and contact the relevant district office if clarification is needed. No payment should be made based on an unofficial fee claim.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Tribal Paramedics Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Form
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form is included on pages 4 and 5 of the official five-page notification and form document. The form requests the applicant's name, complete address, contact information, selected district, community and caste, date of birth, local body or taluk, language proficiency, educational qualifications and professional council registration details. It also includes a declaration confirming that the information provided is true and that the application or engagement may be cancelled if the information is found to be false. Candidates must use the prescribed application form and submit it with the required self-attested certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kerala STDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kerala STDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 250 vacancies: 150 Tribal Paramedics Trainee (Nursing / Pharmacy / other recognised paramedical degree), 100 Tribal Paramedics Trainee (GNM / ANM / other recognised paramedical diploma).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kerala STDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Format on page 4 of the notice; also available from District Tribal Development Offices, ITDP Project Offices, Tribal Extension Offices and www.stdd.kerala.gov.in) and send it to the address given in the notification, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹18,000 per month for Tribal Paramedics Trainee (Nursing / Pharmacy / other recognised paramedical degree), ₹15,000 per month for Tribal Paramedics Trainee (GNM / ANM / other recognised paramedical diploma).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Nursing / Pharmacy / other recognised paramedical degree, or GNM / ANM / other recognised paramedical diploma, from a course recognised by the Government, DME or universities; course fully passed with relevant council registration. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category in Kerala. Applicant must apply in one district only. Course must be fully passed and relevant council registration held.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants applying in more than one district.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary engagement for 1 year only. Training-nature appointment; no claim to permanent appointment in future. Selected candidates must serve subject to directions and orders issued by the Health Department and Tribal Development Department from time to time.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Primary health centres to medical colleges and hospitals under the Health Department, Kerala.
